attempts.status: accepted and integrated after independent source/native review

review.notes: The six poses read as gather → rear-hip load → behind-the-back reach → release → follow-through → recovery. Frames0 and5 share balanced stances but differ in arm positions; frames2–4 clearly show the behind-the-back action. Piper identity and complete anatomy are consistent, no ball is present, transparent alpha is clean, and every figure has >=91px margin on each side.
